meta.description: Structured mathematics and Armenian Heritage learning with verified tutors, lesson-by-lesson feedback, parent-visible progress, and free weekly problem solving.

hero.eyebrow: A managed school, not a marketplace
hero.title: Personalized online tutoring with verified Armenian educators — and progress parents can actually see.
hero.description: Math, programming, and Armenian heritage lessons built around each learner's goals, with structured feedback, milestones, projects, and support between classes.

visual.label: What a parent sees
visual.headline: Steady, visible progress
visual.note: A real trend from feedback after every lesson — not a guess.

howItWorks.title: A clear path from first conversation to visible progress
howItWorks.description: Four steps, the same for every family — no guesswork about what happens next.

one.title: Free consultation
one.body: Tell us about your learner. We listen for goals, current level, and what hasn't worked before.

two.title: Assessment & matched tutor
two.body: A short, low-pressure assessment helps us match a verified tutor suited to your learner's subject and pace.

three.title: A personalized learning plan
three.body: Your tutor builds a plan around real goals — not a generic syllabus — with milestones you can see.

four.title: Visible progress
four.body: After every lesson: structured feedback, updated milestones, and a progress trend you can check anytime.

subjects.title: Every subject, one consistent standard.
subjects.description: From core subjects to test prep, every course follows the same structure: clear goals, real feedback, and work your learner can point to.

heritage.title: Armenian language & culture
heritage.body: Reading, speaking, and writing Armenian alongside history and culture — taught by educators who carry the language as their own, not an afterthought subject.

mathematics.title: Mathematics
mathematics.body: From foundations to advanced coursework, taught for understanding — with practice that builds real fluency, not just answers.

programming.title: Programming
programming.body: Learners build and ship real projects — websites, games, tools — while developing the habits of testing, debugging, and explaining their work.

sat.title: SAT
sat.body: Focused preparation across Reading & Writing and Math, with full-length practice tests and pacing strategy built around your learner's target score.

toefl.title: TOEFL
toefl.body: Reading, listening, speaking, and writing preparation for learners aiming to demonstrate academic English proficiency with confidence.

whyUs.title: Structure and visibility, not a marketplace gamble
whyUs.description: We built the parts a marketplace leaves out: a consistent standard for every tutor, and a clear view of what's actually happening in every lesson.

structure.title: Structure
structure.body: Every learner follows a plan with defined goals and milestones — never an improvised lesson.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.body: Feedback after every lesson and a progress trend parents can check anytime, without asking.

accountability.title: Accountability
accountability.body: Tutors are trained, reviewed, and part of the 2tor team — not independent contractors you vet yourself.

safety.title: Child safety
safety.body: No private adult-child messaging. Every learning space is parent-visible and staff-auditable.

heritage.label: Armenian language & culture
heritage.title: A family-history timeline

forParents.title: Everything you need to know, without managing every lesson
forParents.description: The parent dashboard keeps schedules, feedback, and milestones in one place — so you always know what's happening, without sitting in on class.

schedule.title: Schedules
schedule.body: See upcoming and past lessons at a glance, and reschedule without back-and-forth messages.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.body: Read what the tutor noted after every lesson — what was covered, what to practice next.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.body: Track the goals in your learner's plan as they're reached, not just a list of completed lessons.

progressTrend.title: Progress trend
progressTrend.body: A trend built from real lesson feedback over time — not a guess.

preview.label: Parent dashboard preview
preview.headline: Progress trend, this term
preview.caption: Illustrative preview — built from structured feedback after each lesson.

tutors.title: Educators who are part of our school, not strangers from a listing
tutors.description: Every tutor is hand-verified, trained on a U.S. curriculum, and supported by our team — publicly part of the 2tor name, not an anonymous profile.

testimonials.title: What families notice first

one.question: How does learning start?
one.answer: We begin with a free conversation and, when useful, a short assessment.

two.question: Are groups large?
two.answer: Groups stay small so each learner can receive clear feedback.

three.question: What information do you collect?
three.answer: Only what is needed to contact you and arrange the conversation.

four.question: Can I ask a question before enrolling?
four.answer: Yes. Send a message and the team will reply.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: A calm, practical way to find the right learning format.
howItWorks.body: First we listen: what is going well, where learning has become difficult, and what your family hopes for. Then we recommend a suitable next step, such as a free assessment, a group, or individual support. Learners leave each lesson knowing what to practise and why it matters.

mathematics.title: Mathematics
mathematics.body: Mathematics lessons make thinking visible. Learners work with patterns, representations, explanations, and carefully chosen practice so fluency grows alongside understanding.
mathematics.audience: Learners from early number sense through pre-calculus — whether catching up, keeping pace, or reaching ahead of grade level.
mathematics.curriculumIntro: A structured path through five areas, adapted to your learner's current level and goals.

modules.title: Foundations & number sense
modules.body: Arithmetic fluency, ratios, and proportional reasoning built for real understanding, not memorized steps.

modules.title: Algebra & functions
modules.body: Equations, graphing, and functions as tools for modeling real situations, not abstract symbol pushing.

modules.title: Geometry & trigonometry
modules.body: Shapes, proof, and spatial reasoning, connected to visual intuition and step-by-step justification.

modules.title: Advanced topics & calculus prep
modules.body: Pre-calculus and introductory calculus for learners moving toward higher-level coursework.

modules.title: Problem-solving practice
modules.body: Non-routine problems that build the stamina and reasoning both coursework and competitions reward.

mathematics.ctaBody: See how a lesson works before you commit to anything. Share a few details and we will schedule a free 30-minute mathematics class.

programming.title: Programming
programming.body: Programming starts with purposeful projects. Learners explore logic, data, and design while developing the habit of testing an idea, describing what happened, and trying again.

armenianHeritage.title: Armenian language & culture
armenianHeritage.body: Lessons bring language, history, and creative expression together. Learners read, speak, write, and investigate cultural material in ways that invite genuine participation.
armenianHeritage.audience: Learners at any starting point — from a first introduction to the Armenian alphabet through advanced reading, writing, and conversation.
armenianHeritage.curriculumIntro: A structured path through five areas, adapted to your learner's current level and goals.

modules.title: Reading & writing
modules.body: The Armenian alphabet, phonics, and composition, from first letters to fluent, confident writing.

modules.title: Conversational speaking
modules.body: Everyday conversation and listening practice with a tutor who speaks Armenian as a first language.

modules.title: Grammar & structure
modules.body: The grammar patterns that turn vocabulary into correct, natural sentences.

modules.title: History & culture
modules.body: The people, events, and traditions that give the language its context and meaning.

modules.title: Literature & storytelling
modules.body: Armenian stories, poetry, and folk tales, read and discussed together.

armenianHeritage.ctaBody: See how a lesson works before you commit to anything. Share a few details and we will schedule a free 30-minute Armenian language & culture class.

chess.title: Chess
chess.body: Chess teaches a habit that outlasts the board: look before you move, weigh the options, and own the consequence. Lessons pair tactical patterns with real games, and every session ends with a note on what your child saw and what they missed.

sat.title: SAT
sat.body: SAT preparation is built around your learner's actual gaps, using official-style questions and honest, specific feedback so practice time is never wasted on material they have already mastered.
sat.audience: Students preparing for an upcoming SAT who want a structured plan rather than scattered practice books.
sat.curriculumIntro: A structured path through five areas, paced against your learner's test date.

modules.title: Reading & writing
modules.body: Evidence-based reading, grammar, and rhetoric across the digital SAT's Reading & Writing module.

modules.title: Algebra & functions
modules.body: Linear and nonlinear equations, systems, and function reasoning, the backbone of the Math section.

modules.title: Problem-solving & data analysis
modules.body: Ratios, percentages, and interpreting real data sets and graphs under timed conditions.

modules.title: Geometry & trigonometry
modules.body: The geometry and trigonometry topics the SAT tests most often, with efficient solving methods.

modules.title: Full-length practice & strategy
modules.body: Timed practice tests, pacing, and section-specific strategy review before test day.

sat.ctaBody: See how a lesson works before you commit to anything. Share a few details and we will schedule a free 30-minute SAT class.

toefl.title: TOEFL
toefl.description: Confident academic English, section by section.
toefl.body: TOEFL preparation combines academic vocabulary, exam-specific technique, and structured feedback on speaking and writing, so learners walk into the test knowing exactly what each section expects of them.
toefl.audience: Students preparing to study or work in an English-language academic environment and needing a target TOEFL score.
toefl.curriculumIntro: A structured path through five areas, paced against your learner's test date.

modules.title: Reading
modules.body: Academic passages, vocabulary in context, and efficient reading strategy under time pressure.

modules.title: Listening
modules.body: Lectures and conversations, note-taking technique, and comprehension practice.

modules.title: Speaking
modules.body: Structured practice for independent and integrated speaking tasks, with feedback on fluency and clarity.

modules.title: Writing
modules.body: Integrated and independent writing tasks, from outlining to a polished academic paragraph.

modules.title: Full-length practice & strategy
modules.body: Timed practice sections and section-specific strategy review before test day.

toefl.ctaBody: See how a lesson works before you commit to anything. Share a few details and we will schedule a free 30-minute TOEFL class.

groupLessons.title: Group lessons
groupLessons.body: Groups are intentionally small and structured around participation. The tutor can see each learner’s thinking, and learners benefit from hearing more than one way to solve a problem.

projectLearning.title: Project-based learning
projectLearning.description: Knowledge becomes useful when learners use it.
projectLearning.body: Projects give a reason to bring skills together. Learners research, plan, build, revise, and share work that demonstrates understanding without reducing learning to a score.

parents.title: For parents
parents.description: Understand the learning without having to manage every lesson.
parents.body: We communicate clearly about goals, participation, and next steps. You will see what the learner is practising and how you can support a steady routine without turning home into another classroom.

tutors.title: Tutors
tutors.body: Tutors are selected for subject knowledge, communication, and respectful work with young people. Teaching is prepared, reflective, and built around helping each learner participate with confidence.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Choose a format after you understand the fit.
pricing.body: We discuss the recommended format, frequency, and price before you commit. Your first consultation is free. There are no advertising profiles, lead resales, or surprise data uses behind the conversation.

consultation.title: Free consultation
consultation.description: Talk through what your learner needs.
consultation.body: Share a few contact details and the area you are considering. We only use these details to respond to this request and mark the record for deletion after 90 days.

assessment.title: Free assessment
assessment.description: A short, low-pressure look at current understanding.
assessment.body: An assessment is optional and never a label. It helps us choose appropriate material and gives the first conversation a concrete starting point.

safety.title: Safety
safety.body: We use age-appropriate teaching practices, clear communication channels, and careful escalation when a concern is raised. Learners are never asked to publish personal details to participate.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: The public form collects only contact details and a short request. We do not run advertising trackers on these pages. Form records carry a 90-day retention deadline and should be deleted when that deadline is reached.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Tell us what you are looking for.
contact.body: Use this form for a question about learning, a group, or a practical detail. Please do not include sensitive child information; we will ask only for what is needed if we speak.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: The practical agreement behind a respectful learning relationship.
terms.body: Lesson format, payment, attendance, and cancellation arrangements are confirmed before enrolment. The public site does not create an enrolment agreement by itself.

tutorApplication.title: Tutor application
tutorApplication.description: For educators who make thinking visible.
tutorApplication.body: Tell us how you teach and which subjects you know well. Please share only professional contact information here; detailed screening happens through a separate, secure process.
